name: Fungal-feeding nematodes
description: Nematodes whose stylets puncture fungal hyphae - here feeding on both saprophytic and mycorrhizal fungi. Functional group pooling all fungal-feeding nematode species, grouped by the source on the basis of their shared diet. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
